content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-413. - I.P.C. Section 703.1, Building sewer pipe near the water service.
content.summary:
Section 703.1. Building sewer pipe near the water service,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
703.1. Building sewer pipe near the water service.
Building sewer pipe near the water service shall conform to the Arvada Engineering
                  Standards."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11…
